method: ad hoc script around analysis.solar._run_solar_builder_experiment; not CLI variants. cs_ratio: irr_solar / clear_sky_ghi, missing below 10 W/m2 clear-sky, capped at 2. clearness_stats: per solar point GHI (preceding-hour aligned) / Haurwitz clear-sky GHI at that point's own coordinates, same floor and cap, then mean/std/min/max. regional5: GHI mean per cluster of a deterministic k-means (k=5, farthest-point start from the northernmost point) on (lat, lon * cos 51 deg) of config/weather_points.json solar points. temp_mean: weather_means temp_load (temperature points). no_*: production with one auxiliary stats block removed. azimuth: sin/cos of NOAA solar azimuth at the geometry reference point.
compared: azimuth combined with pointwise clearness and regional GHI
